questions.question: This term describes someone deeply invested in trendy, hype-driven streetwear and sneaker culture, often used both descriptively and as a light insult.
This term describes limited-edition product releases designed to sell out quickly and generate resale demand.
This practice, buying limited items solely to resell at a higher price, is central to hype culture's economy.
This term describes people who camp out or wait in long physical lines for a hyped product release.
This term describes an item's cultural desirability and buzz, independent of its actual retail price.
This Japanese streetwear brand, known for its ape logo and camouflage patterns, was founded by Nigo in the 1990s.
This New York streetwear brand, famous for weekly limited drops and long lines, was founded by James Jebbia in 1994.
This brand, founded by the late Virgil Abloh, became one of the most influential luxury streetwear labels of the 2010s.
This Los Angeles-based streetwear brand, associated with skate culture, is known for its bold graphic box logo tees.
This brand, founded by Kanye West in collaboration with Adidas, blends high fashion sensibilities with streetwear and sneaker culture.

questions.answer: What is Louis Vuitton x Supreme?

questions.question: This ongoing sneaker collaboration between Kanye West and a German sportswear brand produced some of the most hyped sneakers of the 2010s.

This Hong Kong-founded media platform, sharing its name with the trivia pack topic, covers streetwear, sneakers, and pop culture news.
This online marketplace, specializing in authenticated resale of sneakers and streetwear, became a major player in the secondary market.

This social media platform has become central to hype culture, with brands using it to tease and announce upcoming drops.
This term describes automated software used by resellers to purchase large quantities of limited sneakers/streetwear the moment they drop online.

questions.answer: What is the LVMH-Supreme collaboration (a partnership, not a full acquisition)?

questions.question: In 2020, this private equity firm acquired a majority stake in Supreme, valuing the streetwear brand at over $2 billion.
questions.answer: What is The Carlyle Group? (later acquired fully by VF Corporation in 2020)

finalJeopardy.question: This West Coast surf and skate culture of the 1980s and 90s is widely credited as the foundational scene from which modern streetwear culture emerged.
finalJeopardy.answer: What is skate/surf culture (California skate culture)?
